bias.en: Recovery failed · broke $330, SAR turned bearish
bias.zh: 反弹失败 · 跌破 $330，SAR 转为看空

read.en: Broadcom fell 12.2% on Nov 20 to $304.41, its lowest close since Nov 6, trading $301.02–342.90 on heavy volume (2.11x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($336.0), 30-day ($334.4) and 100-day ($362.9), all falling, and the rising 10-day ($338.8) and 200-day ($367.8). MACD is above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram nearly closed; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 20 ($369.82), and RSI is 40.8.
read.zh: 博通 11月20日下跌 12.2%，收于 $304.41，为 11月6日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $301.02–342.90，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 2.11 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$336.0）、30 日（$334.4）和 100 日均线（$362.9）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 10 日（$338.8）和 200 日均线（$367.8）。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图几乎收窄至零；抛物线 SAR 于 11月20日转为看空（$369.82），RSI 为 40.8。

read.en: The close broke all three written supports, $330–345 (averages, Nov 11 and 17 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $307–311 (March lows, Aug 2025 high), then $314–319 (Jan 23, Feb 17 and Oct 30 lows) and $330–336. Support is $295–301 (Nov 20 and Feb 4 lows), then $289.8 (52-week low) and $281.6–287. A close above $311 would target $314–319; below $289.8, $281.6–287.
